items.description: A curated list of resources and projects for working with AWS CloudFormation.
items.title: Awesome CloudFormation

items.description: The following are pre-built CloudFormation Samples demonstrating how to use AWS CloudFormation to construct various canned resources, modules, applications or resource groupings.
items.title: CloudFormation Samples
aws-cloudformation-templates
items.description: Sample AWS CloudFormation templates which are intended to support learning how to declare specific AWS resources or solve particular use cases.

items.title: aws-cf-templates
items.description: Free Templates for AWS CloudFormation
These tools are designed to assist in the authoring and testing process for AWS CloudFormation. Tools include template generation, linting and testing applications.

items.title: cfn-python-lint
items.description: Validate CloudFormation yaml/json templates against the CloudFormation spec and additional checks. Includes checking valid values for resource properties and best practices.

items.title: Former2
items.description: Generate CloudFormation / Terraform / Troposphere templates from your existing AWS resource

items.title: org-formation
items.description: a tool that helps you write CloudFormation for your AWS Organization resources and create links between regular cloudformation resources across your accounts and regions.

items.title: AWSConsoleRecorder
items.description: Records actions made in the AWS Management Console and outputs the equivalent CLI/SDK commands and CloudFormation/Terraform templates.

items.title: cfn-guard
items.description: A set of tools to check AWS CloudFormation templates for policy compliance using a simple, policy-as-code, declarative syntax

items.title: cfn_nag
items.description: The cfn-nag tool looks for patterns in CloudFormation templates that may indicate insecure infrastructure.

items.title: taskcat
items.description: taskcat is a tool that tests AWS CloudFormation templates. It deploys your AWS CloudFormation template in multiple AWS Regions and generates a report with a pass/fail grade for each region.

items.title: cfn-diagram
items.description: CLI tool to visualise CloudFormation/SAM/CDK templates as diagrams.

items.title: Visual Studio Code extension
items.description: CloudFormation Linter integration, autocompletion, reference documentation links on hover

items.title: Authoring and Testing Tools

items.description: This section contains tools which have been designed to improve the experience of interacting with the CloudFormation service through a terminal session.

items.title: sceptre
items.description: Sceptre is a tool to drive AWS CloudFormation. It automates the mundane, repetitive and error-prone tasks, enabling you to concentrate on building better infrastructure.

items.title: rain
items.description: A command line tool for working with AWS CloudFormation. It has tools for creating, comparing, and formatting templates and a pleasant CLI experience for creating, updating, and deleting stacks.

items.title: stacker
items.description: An AWS CloudFormation Stack orchestrator/manager.

items.title: cfn-teleport
items.description: A command-line tool which can move CloudFormation resources between stacks.

items.title: stackup
items.description: Stackup provides a CLI and a simplified Ruby API for dealing with AWS CloudFormation stacks.

items.title: awscfncli
items.description: awscfncli helps build and manage complex AWS CloudFormation stacks.

items.title: cfn-teardown
items.description: Cleanup CloudFormation stacks respecting the order of dependencies.

items.title: CLI Tools

items.description: If you prefer imperative coding, or just using your favourite programming language, the following projects are intended to abstract the creation of AWS CloudFormation templates.

items.title: aws-cdk
items.description: The AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) is an open-source software development framework to define cloud infrastructure in code and provision it through AWS CloudFormation.

items.title: serverless-application-model
items.description: The AWS Serverless Application Model (SAM) is an open-source framework for building serverless applications. It provides shorthand syntax to express functions, APIs, databases, and event source mappings. With just a few lines of configuration, you can define the application you want and model it.

items.title: eksctl
items.description: A CLI tool that uses CloudFormation to create clusters on EKS.

items.title: troposphere (Python)
items.description: The troposphere library allows for easier creation of the AWS CloudFormation JSON by writing Python code to describe the AWS resources. troposphere also includes some basic support for OpenStack resources via Heat.

items.title: OpenJS Architect
items.description: Generate AWS CloudFormation and AWS Serverless Application Model code from a very terse and friendly high level manifest file written in , , or format

items.title: mu
items.description: Similar to how the Serverless Framework improved the developer experience of Lambda and API Gateway, this tool makes it easier for developers to use EKS or ECS as a microservices platform.

items.title: cfndsl
items.description: Ruby DSL for generating AWS CloudFormation templates.

items.title: VaporShell (PowerShell)
items.description: A PowerShell module for building, packaging and deploying AWS CloudFormation templates.

items.title: CloudFormation Snippets for VS Code
items.description: This VS Code extension adds autocompletion for all the resources that AWS CloudFormation supports.

items.title: cfhighlander
items.description: Ruby DSL for generating AWS CloudFormation templates using Cfndsl in a modular and extensible manner

items.title: Code Generation

items.description: When you need to extend AWS CloudFormation to support your own personal or organizational use-cases, the following tools are intended to support the development experience with the original Custom Resources functionality and the new CloudFormation Registry experience.

items.title: custom-resource-helper
items.description: Simplify best practice Custom Resource creation, sending responses to CloudFormation and providing exception, timeout trapping, and detailed configurable logging.

items.title: cloudformation-cli
items.description: The CloudFormation Provider Development Toolkit allows you to author your own resource providers that can be used by CloudFormation.

items.title: cloudformation-cli-python-plugin
items.description: The CloudFormation Provider Development Toolkit Python Plugin allows you to autogenerate Python code based on an input schema.

items.title: cloudformation-cli-go-plugin
items.description: The CloudFormation Provider Development Toolkit Go Plugin allows you to autogenerate Go code based on an input schema.

items.title: cloudformation-cli-java-plugin
items.description: The CloudFormation Provider Development Toolkit Java Plugin allows you to autogenerate Java code based on an input schema.

items.title: Custom Resource Development

items.description: The following third-party vendors have created resource types using the CloudFormation CLI and can be downloaded and added to your accounts via the Registry.

items.title: Datadog
items.description: Creates Datadog::Integrations::AWS, Datadog::Monitors::Monitor, Datadog::Monitors::Downtime, and Datadog::IAM::User

items.title: Atlassian
items.description: Creates Atlassian::Opsgenie::User, Atlassian::Opsgenie::Team, and Atlassian::Opsgenie::Integration

items.title: NewRelic
items.description: Creates NewRelic::Alerts::NrqlAlert

items.title: Fortinet
items.description: Creates Fortinet::FortiGate::SystemAdmin, Fortinet::FortiGate::SystemDns, and Fortinet::FortiGate::SystemInterface

items.title: Spotinst
items.description: Creates Spotinst::Elastigroup::Group

items.title: Densify
items.description: Creates Densify::Optimization::Recommendation

items.title: Dynatrace
items.description: Creates Dynatrace::Installer::Agent

items.title: Third Party Resource Types

items.description: CloudFormation's public documentation is also open-sourced and we love to accept contributions.

items.title: cloudformation-user-guide
items.description: CloudFormation's public documentation source repository

items.title: aws-cfn-resource-specs
items.description: A Completely Tracked, Versioned, and Audited Collection Store of CloudFormationResource.json Specification Files. These are the specification files created by AWS and ingested by tools wrapped around CloudFormation template development, such as most tools listed under the Code Generation section. The repository includes detailed, automatically generated changelogs about each new release, such as information on new resource types and what regions support them.
